Short title, extent and commencement

ACT VI OF 1991
ACT VI OF 1991
CENSUS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the
Census Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th April, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 27th
April, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Act may be
called the Census (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of the long title, Ordinance X of 1959

ACT VI OF 1991

April, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of the long title, Ordinance X of 1959.--In the Census
Ordinance, 1959 (X of 1959), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in
the long title, after the words "population of', the commas and words
", and housing conditions in", shall be inserted.

Ordinance, in the preamble, after the words "population", the commas

Substitution of section 2, Ordinance X of 1959

ACT VI OF 1991
ACT VI OF 1991
CENSUS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the
Census Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th April, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 27th
April, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:--
4. Substitution of section 2, Ordinance X of 1959.--In the said
Ordinance, for section 2 the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"2.
Definitions.--In this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the
subject or, context,--
(a)
"Census" means population and housing census;
(b)
"Census Officer" means any person appointed under section 4;
(c)
"house" includes a building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling;
(d)
"local council" means a local council constituted under any law relating to local Government and includes a
Cantonment Board constituted under the Cantonments Act, 1924 (II of 1924); and
(e)
"prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance:'

5. Amendment of section 4, Ordinance X of 1959.--In the said
Ordinance, in section 4, in subsection (1),--
(a) in clause (i), for the words
"Census Commissioner" the words "Chief Census Commissioner"
shall be substituted; and
(b) In clause (ii), for the words
"Director of Census" the words "Provincial Census
Commissioner" shall be substituted.

(i) in clause (b), for the words
and commas "municipal, district, local or union boards, panchayats,"
the words "local councils" shall be substituted; and
(ii) after the words

Amendment of section 10, Ordinance X of 1959

April, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:--
7. Amendment of section 10, Ordinance X of 1959.--In the said
Ordinance :--
(a) section 10
shall be re-numbered as subsection (1) of the said section;
(b} in
subsection (1), renumbered as aforesaid, for the words, comma and figure
"Evidence Act, 1872" the words comma, figures, brackets and letters
"Qanun-e-Shahadat, 1984 (President's Order 10 of 1984)" shall be
substituted; and
(c) after
subsection (1), amended as aforesaid, the following new subsection shall be
added, namely:--
"(2) The
individual information furnished in the census returns, except-so much of it as
is not traceable to an individual, shall be confidential and shall not be used
fir any purpose other than compilation of statistics.".

8. Amendment of section 11, Ordinance X of 1959.--In the said
Ordinance, in section 11,--
(a) in the
marginal heading, for the word "Municipalities" the words "Local
Councils" shall be substituted;
(b) for the
word "municipality", occurring for the first time, the words
"local council" shall be substituted;
(c) for the
words "Director of Census" the words "Provincial Census
Commissioner" shall be substituted; and
(d) for the
words "municipality or the area within its jurisdiction" the words
"area within the jurisdiction of a local Council or other local
authority" shall be substituted.
